scope: Root-cause and diagnostic design gate for the frozen Phase 4 v4 targeted ordinal-1 machine failure only.

diagnostic_detail_missing_from_frozen_fa: hidden probe IDs, roles and physical coordinates
ownership candidate pixels and arbitration results

independent_original_frame_review.review_input: Original SHA-bound 1920x1080 PPM; a temporary lossless PNG decoding copy was used only because the image viewer could not decode PPM directly.
observations: The predicted yellow dashed trajectory and replay-actual dark-core/white-halo trajectory are both visibly present on the table centerline.
The two routes are nearly coincident for most of the visible vertical run; predicted dashes are composited over the continuous actual route while actual ticks and dash-gap exposure remain visible.
The right product inspector is spatially separate from the centerline trajectory in this frame; no trajectory-inspector intersection is visually present.
The trajectory is rendered over the table, balls and rails, so the frozen image does not support scene geometry as the dominant cause of 49 hidden probes.
The frame alone cannot prove semantic ownership for any final pixel and cannot reconstruct the missing per-probe reason telemetry.

confirmed_implementation_gaps.evidence: v4RenderSemanticAttachment creates a separate single-sample RGBA32UI framebuffer, disables blend/depth/sRGB, and replays trajectory semantic batches only. It does not carry semantic samples through the production scene framebuffer, MSAA resolve, tone map or later product UI pass.
confirmed_implementation_gaps.impact: fromFinalCompositeAttachment cannot be established by this attachment. Product-panel, clip, blend, resolve and final draw ownership are inferred rather than measured.

confirmed_implementation_gaps.evidence: A candidate is marked fromFinalCompositeAttachment=true and correspondsToFinalColor=true when a detached semantic pixel has the expected ID and the frozen PPM pixel falls inside a palette color tolerance.
confirmed_implementation_gaps.impact: Color similarity is not a sample-accurate ownership proof and can produce false negatives or false positives after blending and tone mapping.

confirmed_implementation_gaps.evidence: eligibleComponent requires source component role and primitive ID to exactly equal the candidate role and primitive. Candidate generation also searches only that exact semantic key.
confirmed_implementation_gaps.impact: An actual core probe covered by a predicted dash cannot be rescued by a same-track exposed halo edge, solid dash-gap segment, perpendicular tick or endpoint, despite the approved v4 compound-glyph contract explicitly allowing those components.

confirmed_implementation_gaps.evidence: Candidate normalDistancePx is populated with Euclidean distance, longitudinalDistancePx is forced to zero, and ownedPixelEquivalentArea is a 3x3 same-semantic neighbor count rather than resolved MSAA sample coverage.
confirmed_implementation_gaps.impact: The approved tangent/normal bounds, exclusive pixel-equivalent area and exact final-sample semantics are not demonstrated.

confirmed_implementation_gaps.evidence: The runner calls require(machinePass, ...) before constructing and writing the JSON row that contains per-track coverage, component reasons and hidden probe coordinates.
confirmed_implementation_gaps.impact: The only actual frame is frozen correctly, but the diagnostic fields needed to distinguish the 49 hidden probes were discarded.

confirmed_implementation_gaps.evidence: The 159/159 self-test synthesizes one unique, exact-role, fully owned black-versus-white candidate for every source probe. It does not use a product frame, overlapping trajectories, blended/tone-mapped colors, UI composition or missing candidate cases.
confirmed_implementation_gaps.impact: 159/159 proves isolated audit bookkeeping only; it does not predict ordinal-1 compound visibility.

root_cause_decision.reason: The code cannot implement the approved final-composite compound ownership semantics, but the frozen failure omitted the per-probe data required to prove how many of the 49 hidden probes arise from exact-role cross-track covering, palette/tone-map mismatch, detached attachment ownership, pixel arbitration, bounds or other causes. A specific implementation patch would therefore be premature.

falsifiable_hypotheses.prediction: If panel occlusion is material, hidden probe coordinates or their approved compound neighborhoods intersect the final product inspector rectangle and otherwise qualifying same-track pixels terminate at its edge.
falsifiable_hypotheses.falsifier: Zero hidden-probe neighborhood intersections with the frozen inspector rectangle.

falsifiable_hypotheses.prediction: If balls, rails or table geometry hide probes, production pass order or final pixels show scene ownership after the trajectory pass at the hidden coordinates.
falsifiable_hypotheses.falsifier: The audited production order remains hdr_opaque before trajectory overlay and hidden coordinates retain trajectory-colored pixels after composition.

falsifiable_hypotheses.prediction: Hidden actual-core coordinates fall inside predicted dash-on triangles because predicted is composited last, while exposed actual pixels remain in predicted dash gaps and ticks.
falsifiable_hypotheses.falsifier: No hidden actual-core probe lies inside a predicted final-order triangle in the frozen CPU draw package.

falsifiable_hypotheses.prediction: For hidden exact-role probes, an eligible same-track halo/gap/tick/endpoint pixel exists inside the approved tangent/normal and arc bounds, but current exact role/primitive matching refuses it.
falsifiable_hypotheses.falsifier: A gate-compliant cross-component offline assignment finds no additional qualifying same-track candidates.

falsifiable_hypotheses.prediction: Detached semantic ownership and PPM palette matching disagree around blended, antialiased or tone-mapped trajectory edges, or cannot represent later product UI ownership.
falsifiable_hypotheses.falsifier: A sample-by-sample comparison against a truly integrated final-composite attachment shows identical owners and resolved coverage for every ordinal-1 probe. This falsifier cannot be produced from the existing frozen files alone.

falsifiable_hypotheses.prediction: Multiple probes choose the same best pixel or Euclidean-as-normal/zero-longitudinal approximation changes eligibility versus a true tangent/normal decomposition.
falsifiable_hypotheses.falsifier: Offline arbitration using all candidates and true tangent/normal coordinates reports zero collisions and identical eligibility.

required_next_pure_offline_read_only_dia.requirement: Without Cocoa or OpenGL, deterministically reconstruct the ordinal-1 TrajectoryOverlayDrawPackage from the SHA-bound fixture, camera/profile and source. Emit every immutable source probe ID, track, component, primitive, arc interval, physical coordinate, local tangent/normal, and all semantic triangle bounds in production draw order.
required_next_pure_offline_read_only_dia.acceptance: Exactly 95 unique source probes; ordered digest recorded; no source probe is deleted, merged or renumbered.

required_next_pure_offline_read_only_dia.requirement: Read the original frozen PPM only. For each of the 95 probes, record final RGB neighborhoods, palette distances, edge contrast, panel-rectangle intersection, predicted/actual analytic triangle intersections and all eligible same-track component pixels inside the approved tangent/normal and longitudinal bounds.
required_next_pure_offline_read_only_dia.acceptance: One row per source probe with no PASS claim and an explicit limitation that PPM color cannot prove semantic ownership.

required_next_pure_offline_read_only_dia.requirement: Run two pure-CPU diagnostic classifications over the same frozen package and PPM: current exact role/primitive policy and gate-intended same-track compound policy. Preserve exclusive assignment and denominator. Emit the visible-ID delta grouped by track, source role, substitute component and reason.
required_next_pure_offline_read_only_dia.acceptance: Aggregate, predicted and actual counts reconcile to the same 95-probe denominator; no threshold is changed and no candidate outside the approved bounds is counted.

required_next_pure_offline_read_only_dia.requirement: Produce a static control-flow report proving which diagnostic fields are computed before require(machinePass) and which are lost because result-row serialization occurs afterward. This is a diagnostic report only and may not modify the runner.
required_next_pure_offline_read_only_dia.acceptance: The report accounts for every diagnostic field missing from the frozen receipt and names its in-memory source.

required_next_pure_offline_read_only_dia.requirement: Map every v4 final-composite ownership requirement to exact source lines and classify IMPLEMENTED, APPROXIMATED or MISSING, including MSAA samples, blend, clip, tone map, product UI, component substitution, tangent/normal bounds, exclusive assignment and failure preservation.
required_next_pure_offline_read_only_dia.acceptance: No implementation proposal is admitted until all MISSING items relevant to the 49 hidden probes have a falsifiable test and the probe-distribution ambiguity is closed.

required: D1 through D5 complete with exact SHA bindings and zero GPU use
all 95 ordinal-1 probes reconciled by track/component/reason
a unique or explicitly bounded root-cause distribution supported by falsifiable evidence
negative fixtures covering true panel occlusion, true cross-track coverage, cross-component rescue, final-color mismatch, shared-pixel arbitration and tangent/normal bounds
a proposed fix that preserves every invariant in this gate

decision: FREEZE ORDINAL-1 FAILURE; RUN PURE OFFLINE READ-ONLY DIAGNOSTICS ONLY; DO NOT IMPLEMENT, RERUN, REVIEW OR PROMOTE
